item.title: It's getting SCARY for Alabama! 👻 Is LSU the BIGGEST GAME of Kalen DeBoer's career?!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Boo! It's bye week. Alabama gets to rest before heading to one of the scariest stadiums in the SEC: Tiger Stadium aka Death Valley in Baton Rouge. Kalen DeBoer faces off against Lane Kiffin for the first time. Is it personal for the former Bama OC? Is this the biggest game of DeBoer's Crimson Tide career? Alabama is depleted, but will getting key players back from injury help them against LSU? And now that head coaching jobs are starting to open, will DeBoer's name return to the top of those search lists? AL.com and SEC Shorts' Matt Scalici joins Ben Flanagan to ward of the evil spirits as Alabama creeps closer to the College Football Playoff with absolutely no wiggle room.

item.title: Kalen DeBoer gives update on Dre Kirkpatrick Jr.’s status with the team after missing Texas A&M game
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Kalen DeBoer gives an update on Dre Kirkpatrick Jr.’s status with the team.
Kirkpatrick was ruled out for Alabama’s game with Texas A&M on Saturday after he was suspended for a violation of team rules, per a UA spokesperson.
Kirkpatrick has been a key contributor in the secondary this season and is the son of former Alabama All-American and national champion whose name he shares.
🎥: Nick Kelly
